bio.text: Leroy Comrie is a state senator representing the 14th Senate District in Queens, which includes parts of Jamaica, Cambria Heights, Queens Village, Hollis, St. Albans, Laurelton, Jamaica Estates, Briarwood, Hillcrest and Kew Gardens.
In a November 2025 PoliticsNY Q&A, the senator described Comrie as chair of the Senate Corporations, Authorities and Commissions Committee.

sources.title: Inside Government with PoliticsNY: A Q&A with State Senator Leroy Comrie
